services.name: Helicopter Fun
services.desc: Prepare to elevate your sense of wonder as we delve into the captivating history of helicopters, the driving force behind the exhilarating experiences presented by Cocoa Beach Helicopter Tours. Nestled in the heart of Florida's Space Coast, our tours promise to be a skyward adventure filled with awe and excitement. As we explore the foundations of helicopter technology, it's a testament to human ingenuity that has brought us to the spectacular air tours we offer today in Cocoa Beach. From the visionary experiments of Thomas Alva Edison to the pioneering work of French and Russian innovators, the evolution of helicopters has been nothing short of extraordinary. blurb: Guests take helicopter tours in a Robinson R-44 with up to three passengers, flying over Florida's coastlines and landmarks. Tours offer views of beaches, ports, wildlife, and the Kennedy Space Center. Optional upgrades include doors-off flights and sunset views, with video packages available.
